blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida on Wednesday asserted that based on immigration records, gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang is still in the country. Vida’s statement came a day after Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said that Ang had already left the country through the “backdoor.” In a chance interview, Vida said he was “not aware” of Remulla’s source of information that Ang had already left the country, noting that the Bureau of Immigration’s account showed otherwise. “Of course, we do understand that there were several instances in the past when he got out.
